description.value: MYST Asian Fusion is a multi-award-winning Taiwanese-inspired restaurant on the Kingsway corridor in Burnaby, named 2023 Burnaby Business Excellence Awards Business of the Year and repeatedly recognized as Best Fusion by local media. The team of Taiwanese chefs curates a broad menu spanning breakfast through late-night snacks, drawing on Taiwanese night-market traditions alongside fresh local ingredients. It is part of a growing Lower Mainland chain with locations also in Vancouver and Langley.
